permissions.label: Every website
permissions.grants: Agents can open, read and act on any website in this browser.

permissions.label: Tabs
permissions.grants: Agents can see the title and address of every open tab.

permissions.label: Page scripting
permissions.grants: Agents can read pages, click, type and run scripts in the pages they can reach.

permissions.label: Cookies
permissions.grants: Agents can read, set and clear cookies, including signed-in sessions.

permissions.label: Downloads
permissions.grants: Agents can list downloads and save downloaded files into a task.

permissions.label: Open downloads
permissions.grants: Agents can open files the browser downloaded.

permissions.label: Network activity
permissions.grants: Agents can see the requests pages make, with their headers.

permissions.label: Network response bodies
permissions.grants: Agents can read the response bodies of the requests pages make.

permissions.label: Navigation events
permissions.grants: Agents can tell when a page loads, reloads or comes back from the back-forward cache.

permissions.label: History
permissions.grants: Agents can search and read your browsing history.

permissions.label: Bookmarks
permissions.grants: Agents can search, read and change your bookmarks.

permissions.label: Browsing data
permissions.grants: Agents can clear browsing data such as cache, cookies and history.

permissions.label: Recently closed
permissions.grants: Agents can list and restore recently closed tabs and windows.

permissions.label: Top sites
permissions.grants: Agents can read the sites you visit most.

permissions.label: Read clipboard
permissions.grants: Agents can read what you copied to the clipboard.

permissions.label: Write clipboard
permissions.grants: Agents can put text on your clipboard.

permissions.label: Notifications
permissions.grants: The extension can show a desktop notice when an agent asks for a permission.

permissions.label: Extensions
permissions.grants: Agents can list your installed extensions and turn them on or off.

permissions.label: Privacy settings
permissions.grants: Agents can read and change the browser privacy settings.

permissions.label: Search
permissions.grants: Agents can run a search with your default search engine.

permissions.label: Save page
permissions.grants: Agents can save a whole page as one MHTML file.

permissions.label: Tab groups
permissions.grants: Agents can read and arrange tab groups.

permissions.label: Site settings
permissions.grants: Agents can read and change per-site settings such as cookies, JavaScript and pop-ups.

permissions.label: Proxy
permissions.grants: Agents can read and change the browser proxy settings.

permissions.label: Hide tabs
permissions.grants: Agents can hide and show tabs.

permissions.label: Find in page
permissions.grants: Agents can search page text the way Find in page does.

permissions.label: Browser settings
permissions.grants: Agents can read and change some global browser settings.

permissions.label: Debugger
permissions.grants: The extension can send trusted clicks and keys and read response bodies through the browser debugging protocol.

permissions.label: Containers
permissions.grants: Agents can see and open your Firefox containers, each with its own cookie jar.

permissions.label: Extension storage
permissions.grants: The extension keeps its pairing and your settings.

permissions.label: Background timers
permissions.grants: The extension stays connected while the browser runs.

permissions.label: Current tab
permissions.grants: The extension can work with the tab you open it on.
